---
title: "Chapter 1: Data Visualization"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(
    x = flipper_length_mm,
    y = body_mass_g
  )
) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    data = pengui
)
```
